name: Grand Master Robo
summary: Super Commando Dhruva's archenemy: a half-machine crime lord who leads the worldwide crime network Robo Army. He is also the father of Dhruva's love, Natasha.
origin: Robo is a global crime boss whose left half is metal, with a laser fitted into his left eye. He first turned up in a cameo in Maut Ka Olympic, then got a full story in the 1991 special named after him, Raj Comics' first solo-hero special issue. That issue also introduced his daughter Natasha, whose love for Dhruva keeps pulling her between her father's syndicate and the hero.
powers: Metal left half of his body
Laser built into his left eye

storyline.title: Maut Ka Olympic
storyline.beat: Robo makes a brief first appearance in a Dhruva general issue.

storyline.title: Grand Master Robo
storyline.beat: Special #2 is a full Dhruva vs. Robo story. It introduces Natasha and is often named among Dhruva's best stories.

storyline.title: Commander Natasha
storyline.beat: Robo's past with Natasha comes out, and she leaves Dhruva to rejoin her father's crime syndicate.

storyline.title: The nemesis
storyline.beat: Robo becomes Dhruva's best-known and most frequent villain.

gossip.text: Robo's 1989 debut was just a cameo. His big story arrived two years later.
Special #2, named after him, was Raj Comics' first special issue built around a single hero.
Anupam Sinha says he worked on the Robo special during a break in Mumbai and drew his actual room into one of the last panels.
Grand Master Robo is a robot.
gossip.truth: Despite the name, he's a man. Only the left half of his body is metal, and he has a laser eye.

gossip.text: First printings of the Grand Master Robo special are now rare collectibles.

quiz.q: How is Grand Master Robo related to Natasha?
quiz.why: Natasha, Dhruva's love interest, is Robo's daughter.

quiz.q: Which of Robo's eyes holds a laser?
quiz.why: His left side is metallic, including a laser in the left eye.

quiz.q: What prize did Robo's Olympic Committee offer in Maut Ka Olympic?

A seat on the Robo Army council

theme.tagline: Half man, half machine, all father-in-law nightmare.

facts.text: Robo founded the Olympic Committee, which staged a crime Olympics in Rajnagar in Maut Ka Olympic. Criminals from all over the world competed, and the first prize was the right to hunt down Dhruva.
Robo and Dhruva share a bond of hatred and respect. Each knows that hurting the other would also hurt Natasha, Robo's daughter and Dhruva's love.
Robo once nearly had a change of heart, but Natasha, who had turned rogue over corruption in the system, stopped him from surrendering.
Wikipedia notes a Batman parallel: Dhruva's girlfriend Natasha is the daughter of a major villain, just as Talia al Ghul is the daughter of Ra's al Ghul.
In the futuristic Nagayana series, Natasha is Dhruva's lawfully wedded wife, so there the daughter of Robo is married to Robo's arch-enemy.
Writer-artist Anupam Sinha says he worked on the Robo special while on a break in Mumbai, and he drew the actual room he was staying in into one of the last panels.
A fan-run Raj Comics villains blog says Robo began as a gangster named Robert Sheen, who survived an attack by a rival gangster only because a doctor named Schilder saved him.
In that blog's account, Sheen took his baby daughter Natasha from her mother, Marian. Years later, as Grand Master Robo, he trained her to fight and made her commander of his army.
The same blog says Dhruva once arrested Robo but could not get him punished, because there was no evidence or witness against him, so Robo walked free.
The fan blog also says Robo's body is immune to the poison of the mamba snake, and that he fires a powerful laser beam from his metallic left eye.
Natasha is the only person who knows that Dhruva's sister Shweta is the masked heroine Chandika. In Nagayana she wore Chandika's costume to keep the heroine alive while Shweta was presumed dead.
The Robo special introduced Swarna Nagri, a golden city hidden on the ocean floor. Its warrior Dhananjay first fought Dhruva, then became his friend and gave him the power to breathe underwater.
The same special showed that Dhruva, already known for talking to animals and birds, can communicate with dolphins too.
Page 5 of the Robo special shows a distracted Dhruva adding salt to a halwa instead of boiled eggs, a funny moment Wikipedia uses to show that he eats eggs.
Dhruva's enemies range from ordinary crooks to tricksters, mad scientists, demons and aliens, but Wikipedia calls Grand Master Robo his most implacable foe.
Wikipedia names Robo, Chandakaal and Mahamanav among the best-known and most recognisable villains in Indian comics.
Natasha, Black Cat, Nakshatra and Nostredamas are given as examples of rogues who turned good through what Wikipedia calls the Dhruva effect, since Dhruva believes criminals can reform.
Black Cat (Richa) arrived in 1993 to complicate Dhruva's love life, but he has made it clear to her that his heart belongs to Natasha, his first love.
Robo's left half is metal and a laser sits inside his left eyeball. Wikipedia lists him as leader of the Robo Army, a worldwide criminal network, and as Dhruva's most recurring villain.
SPCL #64, Commander Natasha (1996), explores Robo and Natasha's past and upsets Dhruva's love life, since Natasha leaves him and rejoins her father's crime group.

kidSummary: Grand Master Robo is a crime boss who is half man, half machine, with a laser in his left eye. He is Super Commando Dhruva's biggest enemy, but his daughter Natasha is Dhruva's sweetheart, so the two of them hold back from hurting each other.

story.title: A half-metal boss
story.text: Robo is a crime boss whose left side is metal, with a laser in his left eye. He runs a worldwide group called the Robo Army.

story.title: The crime Olympics
story.text: In Maut Ka Olympic, a body called the Olympic Committee holds a contest in Rajnagar, with the prize being the right to go after Dhruva.

story.title: Natasha
story.text: In the Robo special, Dhruva meets Natasha, who is Robo's daughter. She loves Dhruva, but she is also loyal to her father.

story.title: Hate and respect
story.text: Robo wants Dhruva gone and Dhruva wants Robo arrested, but both hold back, because hurting the other would hurt Natasha.
